description:
One scored replay cell: a line of a ``metrics/backtest-record/`` file.

The pooled back-test record is one append-only file per replay run, never
rewritten once written. A row is a cell a model actually ran and that came
back scored; an offline rehearsal's cells are never recorded.

arm.description: 'standing': a cell of the standing back-test. 'incumbent' / 'candidate': a cell of a comparison run
arm.title: Arm

population.description: The population the run drew from, as a stable name (cert: `cert:<scope>`; merits: `merits:argued`). Figures never pool across populations
population.title: Population

process_digest.description: The process digest of the configuration that ran (see `BacktestComparisonArm.process_digest`). Figures pool within one (predictor, model, digest) and never across them
process_digest.title: Process Digest

stratum.description: The case's outcome class in its population (cert: granted or not-granted; merits: disturbed or not-disturbed), recorded under every draw rule because the pooled figure is post-stratified on it
stratum.title: Stratum

stratum_share.description: That class's share of the eligible population the run drew from, replayable or not. Null under a rule that is not a probability sample (`recency-head`), whose rows no pooled figure includes
stratum_share.title: Stratum Share

title: BacktestRecordRow
